$comment: Which strings are a Yonto type name, by contracts/yonto-type-name.schema.json: the grammar a manifest's `handles` and an index's `ext.yontoType` both $ref. A short id, or reverse-DNS in two or more lowercase RFC 1123 labels. test/yonto-types.test.js walks it against the schema and against a manifest's `handles`; anything else that reads a type name is held to it too.
